source: original immutable state/plan/review records, with separately labeled v2 checkpoint reevaluation

direction.bottleneck: Candidate scoring reads count_nonzero-1 despite right-aligned histories, potentially selecting padding or an earlier interaction instead of the sequence endpoint.
direction.mechanism: Replace the inference readout with a valid-position temporal aggregation anchored at the latest interaction, then vary its recency window and endpoint weight.

direction.bottleneck: Unscaled additions from eight residual convolution blocks may disturb useful item representations and make the encoder harder to optimize under the frozen training schedule.
direction.mechanism: Scale each NextItNetBlock residual update before adding it to the skip connection, while holding trial 7's readout and all eight numeric hyperparameters fixed.

direction.bottleneck: The current Adam learning rate may be mismatched to the attenuated residual encoder, limiting ranking quality reached within the frozen training schedule.
direction.mechanism: Vary only LR while keeping trial 13's model, readout, residual scale of 0.1, and the other seven numeric hyperparameters fixed.

direction.bottleneck: Dropout at 0.2 may impose mismatched stochastic regularization on the attenuated residual encoder at the selected learning rate.
direction.mechanism: Vary only DROPOUT_RATE while keeping trial 23's model structure, LR=0.00025, residual scale of 0.1, readout, and the other seven numeric hyperparameters fixed.

direction.bottleneck: Zero weight decay may provide insufficient control of parameter magnitudes after reducing dropout.
direction.mechanism: Vary only WEIGHT_DECAY while keeping trial 35's model, readout, residual scale, learning rate, dropout probability, and the other seven numeric hyperparameters fixed.

direction.bottleneck: Candidate scoring reads an incorrect sequence position for right-aligned histories and may underuse the most recent valid causal states.
direction.mechanism: Replace count-based indexing with validity-aware, recency-weighted readout of the existing causal encoder states.

direction.bottleneck: Padding-generated activations inside residual convolution blocks may contaminate valid causal states before the existing block-output mask is applied.
direction.mechanism: Propagate the sequence validity mask through residual blocks and zero padded activations before each causal convolution, while retaining trial 9's readout and fixed training conditions.

direction.bottleneck: Unit-gain convolutional residual additions across eight blocks may overwhelm useful skip-path representations and limit ranking quality.
direction.mechanism: Scale convolutional branch outputs before residual addition using fixed scalar gains, while retaining trial 17's masking, readout, and frozen training conditions.

direction.bottleneck: A shared item embedding table may constrain ranking by forcing history encoding and target scoring to use the same representations.
direction.mechanism: Decouple history-input and target-output item embeddings, using the output table consistently for training and candidate scoring while retaining trial 22's encoder, masking, residual gains, readout, and frozen training conditions.

direction.bottleneck: Unconstrained target-item embedding magnitudes may distort dot-product rankings relative to preference alignment.
direction.mechanism: Control target-item embedding magnitudes through norm normalization applied consistently to positive, negative, and candidate scoring, while retaining trial 22's shared embedding table, encoder, masking, residual gains, readout, and frozen training conditions.

direction.bottleneck: Candidate scoring uses count_nonzero-1 as a position index despite right-aligned histories, potentially reading padding instead of recent interaction states.
direction.mechanism: Replace the length-indexed scoring readout with an alignment-aware readout, then vary aggregation weights over recent valid states.

direction.bottleneck: Eight unscaled convolutional residual blocks may accumulate updates that overwhelm the identity path and limit optimization of the corrected model.
direction.mechanism: Scale each convolutional residual update by a fixed coefficient before adding it to the identity path, varying that coefficient while preserving trial 4's scoring readout and other settings.

direction.bottleneck: Eight unscaled convolutional residual blocks may accumulate updates that overwhelm the identity path and limit optimization of the corrected model.
direction.mechanism: Scale each convolutional residual update by a fixed coefficient before adding it to the identity path, varying that coefficient while preserving trial 4's scoring readout and other settings.

direction.bottleneck: Sequence-input dropout at probability 0.2 may remove useful item information from the dominant identity path after strong residual attenuation.
direction.mechanism: Vary only NextItNetModel.dropout's sequence-input dropout probability, preserving trial 23's residual coefficient of 0.015625, convolutional-branch dropout of 0.2, scoring readout, and all other settings.

direction.bottleneck: Unnormalized tied item embeddings may let candidate embedding magnitude distort preference ranking independently of contextual compatibility.
direction.mechanism: Normalize target item embeddings consistently in forward and score_candidates while preserving their use as history inputs, trial 23's encoder, residual coefficient, dropout probabilities, scoring-state aggregation and all other settings.

limitations: One trajectory per arm, no stage-length randomization or attribution-only ablation.
All arms B/C/D use structured attribution review; C adds context reset, D adds optional post-review diagnostics.
D requested and executed zero extra diagnostics; planned controls are distinct from this intervention.
Recovered scores were unavailable to the original agents; original search decisions cannot be counterfactually replaced.
